chapter_seo_title: Chapter 606: Heart-Element, Heart-Pan – Li Huowang Faces Five Enslaved Copies of Himself
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang confronts five enslaved Heart-Elements used as living weapons. A brutal tactical battle of self-mutilation and interrupted commands in the dark cabin.
og_description: Li Huowang discovers five Heart-Elements enslaved as tools by a hidden voice. He must use his own body as a weapon to survive.
twitter_title: Five enslaved Heart-Elements vs. one Li Huowang.
twitter_description: The hidden Heart-Pan is revealed—and so is the nightmare of mass-produced Heart-Element slaves.

lore_anchors.definition: Human-sized ritual incense, often used in large-scale offerings to deities or spirits. Here, they burn on a bronze tripod aboard the ship, suggesting a ceremony without a congregation.
A rare cultivation constitution where the practitioner's beliefs can manifest as reality, blurring truth and falsehood. In this chapter, five are used as enslaved tools by the hidden enemy.
A Heart-Element who becomes the causal anchor for a Siming (a high-dimensional deity). Li Huowang is one, as is the hidden figure in the cabin.
The Mother of the Big Dipper, a high-tier Siming in the Dao-Twisted World. She is associated with life and healing, but her hidden Heart-Pan reveals a darker scheme.
A visible marker often associated with Heart-Elements or spiritually altered individuals in this story. The five enslaved men all share this trait.
A handbell used in Daoist rituals. Li Huowang shakes a rusted one not to summon spirits but to create a jarring noise that disrupts the voice's commands.
A headless female commander whose body is used as a weapon. Her legs are instantly severed by the Heart-Elements' "speak-into-existence" command.
